question: Find the paper on poly-TPD doped PTAA hole-transport layers in the literature collection and report its DOI and the control and optimised PCE. Then use the ML model to predict the PCE of a p-i-n cell with PTAA HTL, PCBM ETL and MAPbI3 (450 nm).
final_answer: The paper on poly-TPD doped PTAA hole-transport layers has the DOI `10.1117/12.2506443`. The control device (with bare PTAA) has a PCE of 12.11%, and the optimized device reaches a PCE of 14.63% (or 14.6%). The predicted PCE of a p-i-n cell with PTAA HTL, PCBM ETL, and MAPbI3 (450 nm) using the ML model is 13.46% (with a 95% interval of [12.27, 14.66]%).
